title: Ivo and the Horizon
author: Zephyrine Dunmore
blurb: Casper Hartwell, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
